## Exact reduction
For endpoint i let E_i be its original directed germ mask, and for each support label l let tag_l be its germ mask. Define T(S) = {l: tag_l intersects S}. T(S union S') = T(S) union T(S'), so count(S)=|T(S)|. The 47-bit label carrier is exact only for this direct support-capacity observer, not later recursive capacity or algebra. The full original six-word and both 98-bit masks are retained below; singleton endpoint identities and E_i retained in stats.

For a six-pencil survivor (A,B), infinity already positive (c=1), and singleton indices in fixed increasing order i_0,...,i_10, every strict extension has a unique binary word, where zero adds E_i to A, one to B. Direct depth-five capacity requires |T(A)|,|T(B)| <=31. Count assignments recursively with state (x,y,k), x=T(A), y=T(B). If either exceeds 31, monotonicity rejects all descendants; if k=11, return one; if both unions with the full remaining singleton label union have size <=31, return 2^(11-k). Otherwise sum the two disjoint children. Induction on remaining depth proves exact counts, including overlapping labels, since each descendant mask lies between current and full remaining union. No label disjointness or factor redundancy assumed. A zero count excludes the entire six-word from any strict full extension. A positive count is only a necessary-condition survival. Counts assignments, not distinct label states or decision trees.

function work(P,G,tag,bank,fifth){
 const groups=[[18,2,0,36],[6,5,43],[48,21,29,23,46],[4,14,16,12,3,8],[26,19,34,20,25,28,39,1,37],[10,15,11,45,49,9,38,42,40,44,47,50]];
 const used=new Set([24,...groups.flat()]),singles=P.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>!used.has(i));
 if(used.size!==40||singles.length!==11||P[24][0]||P[24][1]||!P[24][2])throw Error("singleton/infinity");
 const dirs=[[0n,1n],[1n,9n],[1n,4n],[2n,5n],[1n,17n],[1n,0n]];
 for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const [t,b]=dirs[k],ids=P.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>i!==24&&t*P[i][1]===b*P[i][0]).sort((i,j)=>{let d=P[i][2]*(P[j][0]+P[j][1])-P[j][2]*(P[i][0]+P[i][1]);return d<0n?-1:d>0n?1:0});if(ids.join()!==groups[k].join())throw Error("group reconstruction")}
 const E=P.map((_,i)=>G.filter(g=>g[0]===i).reduce((m,g)=>m|g[2],0n)),lab=m=>tag.reduce((a,t,i)=>t&m?a|(1n<<BigInt(i)):a,0n),T=E.map(lab);
 const pc32=x=>{x=x-((x>>>1)&0x55555555);x=(x&0x33333333)+((x>>>2)&0x33333333);return (((x+(x>>>4))&0x0f0f0f0f)*0x01010101)>>>24;};
 const pc=x=>pc32(Number(x&0xffffffffn))+pc32(Number((x>>32n)&0xffffffffn))+pc32(Number((x>>64n)&0xffffffffn))+pc32(Number(x>>96n));
 const pats=groups.map(ids=>{let out=[];function emit(l,h){let a=0n,b=0n;for(let j=0;j<ids.length;j++)if(j>=l&&j<=h)b|=E[ids[j]];else a|=E[ids[j]];out.push([a,b])}emit(1,0);for(let l=0;l<ids.length;l++)for(let h=l;h<ids.length;h++)emit(l,h);return out});
 const alphabet="0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz",words=[],keyset=new Set();
 for(const line of fifth.trim().split("\n")){const [k,h]=line.split(":"),w=[...k].map(c=>alphabet.indexOf(c)),m=BigInt("0x"+h);if(w.length!==4||w.some((v,i)=>v<0||v>=pats[i].length)||m<=0n||m>>BigInt(pats[4].length))throw Error("fifth row");for(let j=0;j<pats[4].length;j++)if(m&(1n<<BigInt(j))){let u=w.concat(j),s=u.join();if(keyset.has(s))throw Error("duplicate fifth word");keyset.add(s);words.push(u)}}
 if(words.length!==8453||pats[5].length!==79)throw Error("word dimensions");
 let nodes=0,prunes=0,bulk=0,full=0,zero=0,partial=0,all=0,oneStep=Array.from({length:11},()=>[0,0,0]),counts={},out=[],sampleChecks=0;
 const suffix=Array(12).fill(0n);for(let i=10;i>=0;i--)suffix[i]=suffix[i+1]|T[singles[i]];
 function count(a,b,k){nodes++;if(pc(a)>31||pc(b)>31){prunes++;return 0}if(k===11)return 1;if(pc(a|suffix[k])<=31&&pc(b|suffix[k])<=31){bulk++;return 2**(11-k)}let t=T[singles[k]];return count(a|t,b,k+1)+count(a,b|t,k+1)}
 const covered=G.filter(g=>used.has(g[0])).length;
 for(let [i,h] of bank){let m=BigInt("0x"+h);for(let j=0;j<79;j++)if(m&(1n<<BigInt(j))){
  let w=words[i].concat(j),a=E[24],b=0n;for(let k=0;k<6;k++){a|=pats[k][w[k]][0];b|=pats[k][w[k]][1]}
  if(a&b||pc(a|b)!==covered)throw Error("germ partition");
  let x=lab(a),y=lab(b);if(pc(x)>31||pc(y)>31)throw Error("old direct");
  for(let k=0;k<11;k++){let t=T[singles[k]],n=Number(pc(x|t)<=31)+Number(pc(y|t)<=31);oneStep[k][n]++}
  let n=count(x,y,0);full+=n;counts[n]=(counts[n]??0)+1;if(!n)zero++;else if(n===2048)all++;else partial++;
  if(out.length%137===0){let q=0;for(let v=0;v<2048;v++){let aa=a,bb=b;for(let k=0;k<11;k++)if(v>>k&1)bb|=E[singles[k]];else aa|=E[singles[k]];if(tag.filter(t=>t&aa).length<=31&&tag.filter(t=>t&bb).length<=31)q++}if(q!==n)throw Error("brute mismatch");sampleChecks++}
  out.push([i,j,w.join(","),a.toString(16),b.toString(16),n].join(":"))
 }}
 return {stats:{candidates:out.length,full,excluded:out.length*2048-full,zero,partial,all,nodes,prunes,bulk,sampleChecks,oneStep,counts,singles:singles.map(i=>({i,p:P[i].map(String),germ:E[i].toString(16),label:T[i].toString(16)}))},out};
}
